# Mantine.js

## Documentation

### Mantine v6 Documentation

#### Description
- Official documentation for Mantine version 6, a React components library used in this project.

#### Link
- https://v6.mantine.dev/pages/getting-started/


## Definitions

### Mantinejs
- We use Mantine to provide some pre-built React components.
- Refer to the package.json for our current Mantine version.
- The version numbers of @Mantine packages should always be in sync.
- Mantine has a lot of depth, but we aren't currently using much of it.
